dedupe_keys.name: global heating and cooling degree days from gldas 1970 2018

description: The ENERGYA project publishes global heating and cooling degree-day grids derived from GLDAS meteorological data for 1970–2018. At 0.25-degree resolution, the collection provides monthly and annual heating degree-days, cooling degree-days and a wet-bulb cooling variant using several threshold temperatures. PANGAEA distributes downloadable NetCDF4 and GeoTIFF files free under CC-BY-4.0. Values are degree-Celsius days, with the conversion to Fahrenheit days documented. These indicators can supply temperature-dependent demand drivers for building-energy, electricity and district-heating simulations. They complement GLDAS weather fields by expressing accumulated thermal demand proxies. A known limitation is the change between GLDAS versions around 2010–2011, which may introduce artificial breaks at some locations. Thresholds are predefined, and degree-days do not directly measure electricity consumption or building efficiency. The provider offers more recent years on request, but this record describes the verified public 1970–2018 deposit.
name: Global heating and cooling degree-days from GLDAS, 1970–2018
